description: This file contains integration tests for the Eclipse Hono project, specifically testing command and control functionality over AMQP. It includes setup and test cases for sending commands, handling responses, rejecting malformed commands, and verifying device interactions with the AMQP adapter.

classes.name: CommandAndControlAmqpIT
classes.description: Integration test class for verifying command and control interactions over AMQP in Eclipse Hono. It tests sending commands, handling responses, rejection scenarios, and connection setups with device simulations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data such as tenant and device IDs before each test run.

methods.name: createEventConsumer
methods.description: Creates a message consumer for receiving events from the tenant.

methods.name: subscribeToCommands
methods.description: Subscribes to command messages using specified configurations and handler.

methods.name: connectAndSubscribe
methods.description: Establishes connection to the AMQP adapter and subscribes to command and notification channels.

methods.name: createCommandConsumer
methods.description: Creates a message handler that processes incoming commands and sends back acknowledgement responses.

methods.name: createRejectingCommandConsumer
methods.description: Creates a message handler that rejects incoming commands with an error.

methods.name: testSendOneWayCommandSucceeds
methods.description: Tests that a one-way command can be successfully sent and received by a device.

methods.name: testSendAsyncCommandsSucceeds
methods.description: Verifies asynchronous command sending and response handling between application and device.

methods.name: testSendCommandSucceeds
methods.description: Tests sending a command and validating the response received from a device.

methods.name: testSendCommandFailsForMalformedMessage
methods.description: Ensures malformed command messages are rejected with appropriate errors.

methods.name: testSendCommandFailsForCommandRejectedByDevice
methods.description: Checks that command rejection from a device is correctly propagated back to the application.

methods.name: connectToAdapter
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the AMQP adapter, optionally creating message consumers.
